turns.sql:
WITH high_risk AS (
    SELECT s.shipment_id
    FROM Shipments s
    JOIN Orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.product_price > 500
    GROUP BY s.shipment_id
),
shipment_dates AS (
    SELECT s.shipment_id,
           date(o.date_order_placed) AS start_dt,
           date(s.shipment_date) AS end_dt
    FROM Shipments s
    JOIN Orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE s.shipment_id IN (SELECT shipment_id FROM high_risk)
),
date_range AS (
    SELECT shipment_id, start_dt AS dt, end_dt
    FROM shipment_dates
    WHERE start_dt < end_dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT shipment_id, date(dt, '+1 day'), end_dt
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date(dt, '+1 day') < end_dt
)
SELECT AVG(business_days) AS avg_business_days
FROM (
    SELECT shipment_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', dt) NOT IN ('0','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS business_days
    FROM date_range
    GROUP BY shipment_id
);

WITH high_risk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.shipment_id
  FROM Shipments s
  JOIN Shipment_Items si ON s.shipment_id = si.shipment_id
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON si.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_price > 500
),
shipment_dates AS (
  SELECT
    s.shipment_id,
    s.shipment_date,
    i.invoice_date
  FROM Shipments s
  JOIN Invoices i ON s.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  WHERE s.shipment_id IN (SELECT shipment_id FROM high_risk)
)
SELECT
  AVG(
    total_days
    - 2 * weeks
    - CASE
        WHEN start_w = 0 AND end_w = 6 THEN 2
        WHEN start_w = 0 THEN 1
        WHEN end_w = 6 THEN 1
        WHEN start_w > end_w THEN 2
        ELSE 0
      END
  ) AS avg_business_days
FROM (
  SELECT
    shipment_id,
    CAST((julianday(invoice_date) - julianday(shipment_date)) AS INTEGER) AS total_days,
    CAST((julianday(invoice_date) - julianday(shipment_date)) / 7 AS INTEGER) AS weeks,
    CAST(strftime('%w', shipment_date) AS INTEGER) AS start_w,
    CAST(strftime('%w', invoice_date) AS INTEGER) AS end_w
  FROM shipment_dates
  WHERE invoice_date >= shipment_date
);

turns.sql:
WITH shipment_products AS (
    SELECT s.shipment_id,
           o.date_order_placed,
           s.shipment_date,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.product_price > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_flag
    FROM Shipments s
    JOIN Orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Shipment_Items si ON s.shipment_id = si.shipment_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON si.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY s.shipment_id, o.date_order_placed, s.shipment_date
),
business_days_calc AS (
    SELECT shipment_id,
           high_risk_flag,
           julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed) AS total_days,
           CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) AS full_weeks,
           (julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7 AS remaining_days,
           CAST(strftime('%w', date_order_placed) AS INTEGER) AS start_weekday,
           CASE
               WHEN (julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7 = 0 THEN 0
               ELSE
                   CASE
                       WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', date_order_placed) AS INTEGER) + ((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7) <= 5 THEN ((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7)
                       WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', date_order_placed) AS INTEGER) = 6 THEN ((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7) - 1
                       ELSE ((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7) - 2
                   END
           END AS extra_weekdays,
           (CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 5 +
            CASE
               WHEN (julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7 = 0 THEN 0
               ELSE
                   CASE
                       WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', date_order_placed) AS INTEGER) + ((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7) <= 5 THEN ((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7)
                       WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', date_order_placed) AS INTEGER) = 6 THEN ((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7) - 1
                       ELSE ((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) - CAST((julianday(shipment_date) - julianday(date_order_placed)) / 7 AS INTEGER) * 7) - 2
                   END
            END) AS business_days
    FROM shipment_products
)
SELECT AVG(business_days) AS avg_business_days_high_risk
FROM business_days_calc
WHERE high_risk_flag = 1;
